status: Review and three concepts complete; awaiting direction selection

browser.consent: Initial captures preserve consent overlay; chose Not now for subsequent mobile and clean workflow captures. No analytics accepted.

scope: Eight representative public pages; source map includes shared orchestrator template. No production code changed or deployed.

reviewed_pages.finding: Distinctive identity and concrete opening, but the same promotional scale is overused on internal pages.
reviewed_pages.recommendation: Reserve the strongest brand expression for this page; favor genuine product evidence over abstract diagrams.

reviewed_pages.finding: Tall hero and count grid delay the three useful entry points.
reviewed_pages.recommendation: Bring Learn, Connect and Start to the opening; show concise links to useful jobs.

reviewed_pages.finding: No workflow results or filters in the first desktop or mobile viewport. Repeated decorative cards dominate the long page.
reviewed_pages.recommendation: Compact title, immediate filters and compact results; move the general definition beneath browsing.

reviewed_pages.finding: Starting request and required inputs follow a large hero and oversized problem statement. Many boxed reference sections compete.
reviewed_pages.recommendation: Show request, inputs and output first; use a contents rail and compact stages; keep recovery and role details accessible further down.

reviewed_pages.finding: Large left-aligned hero leaves unused right space; reading begins in a differently aligned column. Mobile table handling needs focused follow-up.
reviewed_pages.recommendation: Align title, metadata and prose; modest heading scale; reuse contents navigation where useful; ensure tables scroll clearly on mobile.

reviewed_pages.finding: Generic diagram repeats workflow treatment; many long boxed contract bullets.
reviewed_pages.recommendation: Compact mission, responsibilities and input/output summary; linked workflows and detailed contract follow.

reviewed_pages.finding: Oversized identity and repeated provider heading delay setup/actions. Secondary helper text appears difficult to read.
reviewed_pages.recommendation: Show supported work and connection requirements first, then searchable action reference; improve text contrast.

reviewed_pages.finding: Helpful contents rail already exists, but the opening consumes nearly the entire desktop viewport.
reviewed_pages.recommendation: Keep the guide rail and step structure; reduce opening height and expose the first step sooner.

cross_template_findings.change: Use smaller internal-page titles and remove repeated generic diagrams.

cross_template_findings.finding: Diagrams misattribute planning and role selection to StackOS.
cross_template_findings.change: Describe agent reasoning and StackOS scope, explicit execution and records accurately.

cross_template_findings.finding: Two navigation bars plus breadcrumbs consume space; mobile category strip hides later items off-screen.
cross_template_findings.change: Simplify navigation hierarchy and provide clear mobile access to every category.

cross_template_findings.finding: Consent competes with page content, especially on mobile.
cross_template_findings.change: Retain clear choices in a more compact accessible composition.

cross_template_findings.finding: Small labels and low-contrast secondary text risk poor readability.
cross_template_findings.change: Measure contrast and keyboard/focus behavior during implementation; increase diagram-label readability or remove diagrams.

preserve: Real source-backed content, useful links and evidence tables
Public URLs, headings, server-rendered text, canonical metadata and internal links
Current source owners: workflow/preset public fields and article Markdown
Current approved voice; concept copy is not a new brand foundation
limits: Visual review is not a full accessibility audit or measured usability study.
Homepage full-page capture may contain off-screen animation/lazy-render states; empty regions are not established rendering defects.
Orchestrator template was mapped from source but no separate live orchestrator screenshot was captured.
ImageGen concepts are raster design proposals. Generated helper text must be reconciled with approved source copy during implementation.
No ranking or conversion improvement is established by this design review.
next_sequence: Adapt it to catalog, workflow, article, integration and role templates while preserving their different reader tasks.
Implement shared navigation/type/spacing first, then templates, through the existing engineering workflow.
Verify desktop/mobile, keyboard access, contrast, crawlable content and URL/metadata preservation before release.
